Title: Advantages of Writing Code with AI
Summary: How AI-powered tools impact developer productivity and their integration into daily workflows.
Content: AI tools are fundamentally changing the software development process. With tools like GitHub Copilot and Claude, boilerplate code writing is minimized while developers can focus on more creative and architectural work.

Title: Modern Web API Development with .NET Core
Summary: Fundamentals and best practices for building RESTful services with ASP.NET Core Web API.
Content: .NET Core is an ideal framework for modern web API development with its cross-platform support and high performance. It enables rapid prototyping with the minimal API approach and scalable architecture with controller-based structure.
